reviewer: primary implementation agent; not independent audit
scope: Complete reads of the listed authored files. Does not claim dependency review, absence of all vulnerabilities or live mainnet readiness.

findings.description: Native attacks/token rollback were tested while the compiled-WASM path only exercised valid chain steps. Added actual-WASM variants; four filtered tests passed including the existing successful chain.

Client rejects identity proof components more strictly than host pairing semantics. Protocol nonidentity requirement explicitly applies to encryption points; no pinned-VK soundness exploit identified. Runtime unchanged.

limits: Exact allowlisted token semantics are trusted; fee-on-transfer or malicious custom tokens are unsupported.
Trusted RPC authentication is not an independent SCP inclusion proof.
Parallel append contention can stale a proof; no automatic signing/resubmission is justified.
Single-operator phase2, real trustee independence, legal authority, actual chain archival restoration and live private app integration remain separate release requirements.

files.review: All entrypoints, immutable configuration, canonical public-vector construction, replay/commitment predicates, window/root/capacity checks, authorization before deposit, effects and atomic token calls, durable archive indices and errors.
Network/contract/address domain separation, exact ScVal XDR hashing, lossless digest splitting, Poseidon parameters and asset-tree construction; constants cross-language checked by existing fixtures.
Pinned VK hash, exact public-input length, canonical Fq/Fr boundaries, G2 order, MSM and four-pair Groth16 equation. Host handles subgroup validity; no accepting verifier substitution.
Compared both byte arrays against actual generated key digests and public fixture provenance.
Reviewed all committed empty-tree constants against their use in pool construction and cross-language proof chain.
Read all predicate/hash/address/config/storage tests and fixed synthetic SAC ledger setup. Native TTL fixture explicitly does not claim real archive restoration.
Read actual pinned proof loading, both native/WASM chains, real SAC failure rollback and adversarial tests. Added compiled-WASM variants for each of three formerly native-only attack/rollback paths.

Reviewed intrinsic artifact snapshots/hashes, canonical points/scalars, subgroup restrictions, exact157/4 signals, lazy single-thread snarkjs proving and Noble pairing equation including zero aggregate IC term.
Read initialization, single outstanding request, error closure, timeout, pending rejection and Worker.terminate transport. Cancellation is not physical erasure.
Authored/reviewed sequential local check runner, locked build, fixed committed public fixtures, failed-step report preservation and interruption handling. No live operations.

Complete read: exact structured-message validation, initialized-adapter requirement, single outstanding worker operation, error responses without witness data, local-only proving/verification and dedicated-worker installation.
